description: Fetches a conversation with every message decoded like get_message: headers, text bodies (HTML only when a message has no text part or include_html=true), attachment metadata and truncation flags. Messages come oldest-first. To reply to the conversation, take the LAST message's threadId, headers.messageId and subject and pass them to send_message (thread_id, in_reply_to, subject with "Re: "). Long threads can be large — lower max_body_chars (it applies per message) when only the gist is needed.

include_html.description: Return decoded HTML bodies even when a text body exists (default false).

max_body_chars.description: Truncate each decoded body at this many characters (default 50000; a truncation flag is set when cut).

thread_id.description: The thread id from list_threads or from a message's threadId field.

name: get_thread
title: Read a whole conversation
